name: MAIA GPU Solver
description: Builds MAIA CFD solver with NVHPC + CUDA (stdpar) for NVIDIA GPUs. Includes regression testing and profiling tools.

pstlPreset.description: GPU architecture preset for NVHPC stdpar (-gpu=ccXX)

enableComponents.description: Comma-separated list of components to enable (avg,dg,lbm,particle,structured). Empty = all enabled.

disableComponents.description: Comma-separated list of components to disable (avg,dg,lbm,particle,structured)

runTests.description: Run bin/test_maia after a fresh build. Off by default: test_lb_latticedescriptor.cpp's GPU parallelFor case is a known pre-existing crash on some architectures/drivers, so this mostly adds noise; turn on when you specifically want the sanity check on a new node/GPU.
